svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Enterprise agent platform on EKS: the minimum useful platform
svg.desc: Layers from consumers at the top through identity, the Agentgateway control point, execution, tools and services, to state and telemetry, with each component colored by whether it is reused, adopted, built, optional or deferred.
svg.text: Agent platform on EKS: the minimum useful platform
One governed path for models, tools and agents. Execution stays conventional unless a workload earns a second operating model.
Agentgateway: the only door to models, MCP tools and agents (OSS, Kubernetes Gateway API controller)
per-tool CEL on role and current actor
Every route: verify token (Keycloak, chain-sts, workload key) | coarse authorization | rate limits per principal | usage record (user, team, workload, workflow, model) | OTel span
1.0 is rc: pin, do not expose
BEHIND THE GATEWAY (TOOLS OWN THEIR BUSINESS AUTHORIZATION)
IAM role; no app holds a key
TELEMETRY AND RECORDS (FOUR STREAMS, ONE COLLECTOR)

EKS, VPC, ECR, KMS, Secrets Manager, Istio (mTLS between gateway and tools, where already run), Karpenter (On-Demand/RI for tier-0, Spot for interruptible), Kyverno (admission rules that keep the gateway the only door)
Adopt: new OSS, run by the platform
Optional: per workload, after a gate
Deferred: not built until a workload needs it
Arrows show request direction. Dashed boxes are optional or deferred.
Every consumer reaches models, tools and agents through Agentgateway. Business authorization stays in tools.
Nothing in Distribution or Telemetry is in the request path: their outage does not stop agents.
